content:
The execution failed due to a root-level schema mismatch and incorrect field naming conventions in the medication and totals objects.
The agent used the root key 'decision' instead of the required 'recommendation', causing the markdown summary check to fail. Medication objects used 'annual_margin_difference_usd' instead of the expected 'annual_margin_difference_90_minus_45_usd' and included an extra 'annual_doses_per_medication' field. The 'totals' object failed validation because the mandatory 'total_annual_margin_difference_90_minus_45_usd' key was missing or misnamed.
